sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO TD_ROLE_PERMISSION (role_id, permission_id, created_time, created_by) VALUES (#[roleId], #[permissionId], now(), 'system')
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM TD_ROLE_PERMISSION WHERE role_id = #[roleId] AND permission_id = #[permissionId]
sqlMap.select: SELECT role_id as role_id, permission_id as permission_id FROM TD_ROLE_PERMISSION WHERE role_id = #[roleId]
